        """A regular property."""
        return "regular"
    
    @classmethod

        """A class property."""
        return "class"

        return "static"
'''

                print(f"isproperty(__func__): {isproperty(member.__func__)}")
                
            print()
    
    finally:
        os.unlink(temp_file)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_current_behavior()
